Subject: Exec seat lattice & demo escort plan

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We want to make the executive portion of the demo as efficient as possible for your CIO and VP. Proposed plan: a 40-minute demo with a 15-minute pre-brief for execs (VP/CIO) + 25-minute live walk of the product focusing on latency, routing/fallback, and data controls.

Candidate windows (PT):
- Tue May 4, 10:00–10:40 or
- Tue May 4, 15:30–16:10

If neither works, happy to propose Wed morning. Can you confirm which slot the CIO prefers and whether the VP can join for the pre-brief? If helpful, we can also provide a short one-pager and a mutual action plan ahead of time.

I copied Lauren (exec coordination) and Priyom (solutions) to help lock the invite and prep materials.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Hi Ben —

Thanks — quick note from our side: the CIO (Mark Turner) strongly prefers an afternoon slot. VP (Carla Ruiz) is tighter on time and would only join if the exec pre-brief is limited to 10–15 minutes.

Of the two times you suggested, the 15:30–16:10 PT slot is better for Mark. I copied Tom (our executive scheduler) to help with invites — Tom, can you please hold 15:30–16:10 PT on May 4 for a Redwood demo and confirm if Carla can do the pre-brief?

Also, could you send a 1-page agenda and anything security-related we should review (SOC2/KMS notes) in advance?

Appreciate it,
Elena
Head of Partnerships | Argus Cloud
elena@arguscloud.com

Great, thanks for the direction. I updated the mutual action plan and attached two docs: Argus-MAP-v1.xlsx (timeline + roles) and Redwood-Exec-OnePager.pdf (30s overview + security highlights).

Proposed final flow for May 4, 15:30–16:10 PT:
- 15:15–15:30 PT: 15-minute exec pre-brief (Carla, Mark optional)
- 15:30–15:45 PT: executive-focused walkthrough (routing, fallbacks, SLAs)
- 15:45–16:05 PT: product deep-dive (ops, quantization, cost levers)
- 16:05–16:10 PT: next steps / mutual action items

If Carla can only join for 10 minutes, we'll prioritize the pre-brief for the CIO and make sure the VP sees the condensed exec highlights in the one-pager. Lauren — can you create the invite and set the 15-minute pre-brief as separate calendar item for execs? Priyom — we'll need a 5-slide security snapshot for the pre-brief (SOC2, KMS, retention, audit logs).

Ben
